# Themes 0.5 public API

The 1,186 previous named/type/path pairs have 1,125 KEEP, 60 REMOVE and one MOVE decision. The canonical Toaster destination gives 1,126 retained pairs. The 199 exact export keys replace three open patterns while preserving supported CSS/template targets. Ambient global JSX is retired separately; use the scoped JSX type from Core.
